title: KB HOME OPENS AURORA, A NEW COMMUNITY WITHIN ONE LAKE, A DESIRABLE MASTER PLAN IN FAIRFIELD, CALIFORNIA
summary: KB Home (NYSE: KBH), one of the largest and most trusted homebuilders in the U.S., today announced the opening of Aurora, a new-home community within the One Lake master plan in Fairfield, California. Aurora at One Lake at a Glance: Price: From the $590,000s Location: Fairfield, California, at the corner of Vanden Road and One Lake Drive Home type: Two-story, single-family detached homes Bedrooms/baths: Up to 5 bedrooms and 3 baths Schools: Travis Unified School District Amenities: Resident access to One Lake's resort-style pool, spa, club lounge, community center, kitchen, amphitheater, fire pit, yoga area, parks, barbecues, playgrounds and trails, all situated around a scenic lake Aurora at One Lake is in an ideal location that provides convenient access to the Fairfield-Vacaville Hannigan Capitol Corridor ® train station, Interstate 80 and the North Bay's major employers, including Travis Air Force Base. The new community is a short drive to Nut Tree Plaza and Vacaville Premium
